label: MacBook Air 15-inch (M3)
description: 15.3-inch version of the fanless M3 Air, same port set: two Thunderbolt/USB 4, MagSafe 3, Wi-Fi 6E.
notes: No Ethernet port on any Air model. Wired only through a USB-C/Thunderbolt Ethernet adapter at 1GbE (2.5GbE with a faster dongle); Wi-Fi 6E is the built-in uplink.
